issue: Off-by-one in length limit: a query of exactly 100 chars after trim is rejected, but AC6 requires 100 -> 200 and only 101 -> 400
evidence: `if (q.length >= MAX_QUERY_LENGTH)` with MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 100: q = 'a'.repeat(100) returns 400, expected 200; should be `>`

issue: No 'single string' validation: repeated or non-string q is coerced with String() instead of returning 400 { error: 'Query must be a single string' }
LIKE wildcard `_` is not escaped (AC8); only backslash and % are
evidence: q=_ gives pattern '%_%', which matches every title with at least one character; expected []

issue: Author is matched with case-sensitive instr(author, ?) instead of LIKE ? ESCAPE, so author search is not case-insensitive (AC2/AC3) and deviates from the spec
evidence: `title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR instr(author, ?) > 0`: q=fowler does not match author 'Martin Fowler', so Refactoring is missed
